title: Protobuf: improve the speed of loading protobuf language files
description:
If a large number of *.proto files need to be parsed during loading, the speed will become very slow because the efficiency of g_slist_append(https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/blob/main/glib/gslist.c#L204-255) is very low because it uses g_slist_last(https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/blob/main/glib/gslist.c#L818-839) which traverses the entire list to find the end.

So this change includes:

1. Replace the g_slist_append() with g_slist_prepend() where the order is not important.

2. Replace the GSList type with GQueue where the order is important.
